description: The world's own command: /加面 (typed as its key, /extra_noodles, because DSH names a command in lower case ASCII) raises its flag for the turn, and a trigger waits on the flag and tells the game master the owner brings a second bowl. A world whose command word is not in ASCII, so that the key a word is offered under is what the player types.

commands.description: 要求陈姨再加一碗面：她把面端上来，并收下这碗的钱。

effects.text: 午饭时间到了，面馆里的座位一下子坐满了人。
玩家要了一碗加面：陈姨应当把热面端上来，并收下这碗的钱。
